strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: Mid-size food and beverage manufacturers (500-5,000 employees). Warehouse-heavy. Roles: Ops director, Logistics director, VP supply chain.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: Free freight spend audit, we send back a savings map in 5 business days. CTA: Request the audit.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: RouteHaven cuts LTL freight spend 12% in the first 90 days for food and beverage shippers.
